entries.partTitle: Authentication vs Authorization & The Coarse-Grained RBAC Model

spec.title: Authentication identity verification versus authorization access governance

left.title: Authentication Identity
items: Verifies who the user claims to be
Evaluates passwords or one-time codes
Establishes authenticated principal id

right.title: Authorization Access
items: Governs what principals may perform
Evaluates permissions against actions
Groups permissions into assigned roles

steps.caption: Authentication verifies the identity of an authenticated principal.
Individual permissions are grouped into roles assigned to users.

spec.title: Vertical administrative escalation versus horizontal tenant tampering

left.title: Vertical Privilege Escalation
items: Low privilege users acquire rights of superior roles
Endpoints assume only administrators will call them
Missing server side role and capability validation

right.title: Horizontal Privilege Escalation
items: Attackers access resources of peer privilege tiers
Tampering with object identifiers in request paths
Failing to enforce tenant and ownership query scoping

steps.caption: Vertical privilege escalation occurs when users acquire superior rights.
Data access queries must enforce ownership scoping to protect resources.
